about: [O1] The river is the end (brief O1 §3): by real keys, the car down the slipway at Baxter's foot into the water - 'The river took it.', the kit's black, up on the quay by the steps with a car at the kerb by them (E: in again); then on foot off Pier 7's open end - 'Into the river.', up on the quay again. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1_river.json

steps.expect: G.lastFail && G.lastFail.why === 'The river took it.' && G.lastFail.warnedFor > 0.3
steps.label: the car into the river: warned first ('The river.'), then the words
up on the quay, a car at the kerb by me

steps.eval: ({ me: [N.controller.pos.x.toFixed(1), N.controller.pos.z.toFixed(1)], car: [G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1), G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], prompt: G.hud.promptShown })
(() => { const c = G.city.car, C = N.controller; C.setPose(C.pos.x, C.pos.z, Math.atan2(-(c.pos.x - C.pos.x), -(c.pos.z - C.pos.z)), -0.1); return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const c = G.city.car; return [[c.pos.x + (N.controller.pos.x - c.pos.x) * 0.35, c.pos.z + (N.controller.pos.z - c.pos.z) * 0.35]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const C = N.controller; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(91, 525); C.setPose(91, 525, Math.PI, 0); return 1; })()

steps.label: a man off the pier's end: warned first, then the words
